note: Bridger-Teton NF (Jackson RD) campground on the Wild & Scenic Hoback River, 8 mi E of Hoback Junction on US-189/191 (21 mi from Jackson). Sites can be tight for large rigs. --Claude
summary: FS page + FS layout map: 13 single-family sites + host, all first-come (no recreation.gov listing), $20 ($10 2nd vehicle, half price before the water is on, free after closing), vault toilets, potable water only from the host-site tank. Waterfront: the Hoback is ~40-50 m wide here (a river); one spur ends ~19 m from the water over an open gravel bank, the other river-side sites are 25-40 m back through willow/shrub -> recommend riverfront -> riverview (keep riverfront only if one site is enough).
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend riverfront -> riverview; reviewer may keep riverfront with a caveat): the Hoback River is ~40-50 m wide at the campground (river-size). On zoom-19 imagery one back-in spur ending at ~43.28051,-110.59576 (an RV parked on it; site 3 or 4 on the FS layout map) sits ~19 m from the water down an open gravel bank - clearly on the water. The other river-side sites (map 4/5, 14, 12, 11) are ~25-40 m from the river through willow and deciduous shrub; the north spur near the host site (~43.28073,-110.59526) ~17 m but through trees. One clearly waterfront site of 13 is short of 'a few'; stored evidence ('RV site pads on the riverbank ... open bank') overstates it.
